notes.title: Bucko Playtest V0.1.0
notes.content:
GLOBAL
• You can now play with an xBox controller! 🎮
• Disable ability to move while intro video is playing
• The same music cannot be played twice in a row
• Swimming SFX stop when exit water and when under water
• Few changes on camera collider settings

MODULAR BUILDING SYSTEM
• Script optimizations for better performance
• Improved snapping ability of all slopes
• New tooltip system in buildable objects menu
• Autoscroll in buildable objects menu when navigating with controller
• Blueprint shader improvement to better show when an object isn't buildable

notes.title: V0.0.2
notes.content:
• Bug fix - Snapping areas (in blue) are now hided when we quit the build mode
• Add overlay behind Inputs Helper
• Add build version number in the lower right corner
• Add Bucko Logo to pause menu
• Add Join Discord button to pause menu
• New yellow color in UI
• Increase scroll strength in the buildable objects menu
